notes: Spoken NPC lines (docs/NPC-VOICE-PLAN.md). Audio is generated by the user in ElevenLabs and kept under Voice/<NPC>/source; Tools/build_npc_voice.py turns each line into Voice/<NPC>/<id>.wav plus a loudness envelope (generated Unreal/Chuck3D/Source/Chuck3D/NPCVoiceData.h) and Tools/import_npc_voice.py imports the wavs to /Game/Art/Audio/Voice/<NPC>/VO_<NPC>_<id>. Line text and voices are the user's. Besides 'talk' (spoken when Chuck talks to the NPC), an NPC can have 'ambient' lines the game starts by itself (the tavern at night, DockNPC.cpp StartTavernNight); an ambient line with no 'source' yet is built text-only, timed from its words, until its audio arrives.

ambient.note: user 2026-10-06: Dougmund's night rant in the tavern, looped with a short pause until the keeper cuts him off
ambient.text: I’ve said it before an’ I’ll say it again — for all ’is faults, Herod was a musical GENIUS! I mean, take “Fortune Favors the Kobold.” It’s like that sayin’, y’know? About fortune an’ the bold… but instead it’s KOBOLDS! Get it?! But tha’s just my point, innit? Kobolds ARE bold! I never thought about it before, but they are! They ARE! [blows raspberry] ’E was a visionary.

ambient.text: Awright, awright, that’ll do, Dougmund. Give it a rest, would ya? …Chuck! There y’are. Been waitin’ for you to come round.
